text:
maria.chen: Heads-up — I started a canary rollout using the new traffic-attenuator guard but the infra patch is scheduled in the same change window. Can we avoid overlapping windows?

deploy-bot: Deploy requested by @maria.chen: model-service vR1027 -> canary 5% across eu-west. Rollout policy: `attenuator: true`, `guard: traffic-attenuator-v1`

maria.chen: snippet of the rollout config for reference:
```yaml
rollout:
  strategy: canary
  initial_percent: 5
  guards:
    - type: traffic-attenuator
      params:
        ramp_seconds: 600
        jitter: 0.02
```

omar.patel: Quick q — does the attenuator honor experiment_id when an A/B test is attached? We can't leak users between experiments. :eyes:

liang.wu: It should. The attenuator runs at routing-layer with experiment scoping. But edge case: if experiment binding updates during a ramp, traffic can be misrouted. We should pin experiment ids for the duration of ramp.

janelle_rm: Change window clash is real. Infra patch downtime window is 1962345800-1962347400. Can we move the canary earlier or delay the infra patch?

kyle_sre: Prefer pushing canary to after the infra patch. If patch causes pod restarts we want a clean baseline first. Also request: add a telemetry gate that requires 5m rolling error-rate < 0.5% before each percent increase.

maria.chen: Good call. I can shift the canary to start at 1962345900, which is 10m after the patch starts, but only if ops confirms patch is non-disruptive. Otherwise we wait till patch finishes.

analytics-bot: Recent telemetry note: last infra patch (1961900000) correlated with a 3x spike in 5xx for ~7m. Suggests risk if we run canary concurrently.

liang.wu: So plan: pause current rollout, add telemetry gating and experiment pinning, then schedule new change window post-patch.

maria.chen: @deploy-bot please hold approvals and pause the rollout.

deploy-bot: Action: rollout paused. Approval queue updated: awaiting explicit approvals from @janelle_rm and @kyle_sre to resume. To resume run: `/deploy resume 1962345678 --by maria.chen`

janelle_rm: approving to resume after patch completes and telemetry gate is in. :thumbsup:

kyle_sre: Approve but require rollback playbook link in the release notes. Add `rollback: fast-fail-percent=1` to policy.

maria.chen: added rollback flag and telemetry gate. New policy snippet:
```yaml
rollout:
  strategy: canary
  initial_percent: 5
  guards:
    - traffic-attenuator:
        ramp_seconds: 600
        jitter: 0.02
        pin_experiment: true
    - telemetry-gate:
        metric: error_rate_5m
        threshold: 0.005
  rollback:
    fast_fail_percent: 1
```

omar.patel: One more: make sure the console shows explicit A/B test bindings in the rollout detail so analytics folks can audit. Otherwise they won't trust the split.

liang.wu: I'll add a per-step metadata field that surfaces experiment_id and client cohorts in the console UI.

analytics-bot: NOTE: will subscribe to rollout events matching `attenuator` and annotate dashboards automatically.

maria.chen: Thanks all. I'll reschedule the canary to 1962347500 (post-patch) and reopen when ops confirms patch success. Leaving this thread open for final handoff.

janelle_rm: Sounds good. Ping here when ready and I'll do the final approval handoff. :white_check_mark:
